name: aleogr
description: Orchestrator: checks tools and plans and creates the shared platform (shared project, budget alert and the shared Cloud SQL database with its night switch) and prepares the login of the organization as far as a command can, and declares, plans and applies a project's GitHub repository, proposes a change to it by pull request, generates its Go components and CI file, makes the check ci required once that file is merged, and creates the ground of the environment dev on Google Cloud: its GCP project and APIs, the Docker image repository with its cleanup policy, and a keyless CI identity that may push images to it.
